items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: Thomas Copeland, he had three bass players on the drums. ... You ever played with them? No, no.

ctx.x: Yeah, Alfred on drums. Yeah. Thomas Copeland, he had three bass players on the drums. Yeah. I think that was. You ever played with them? No, no. They had a whole couple of bands. Yeah.
They had Joe Watson I think on the ground.
